product_metadata.title: Balichun King Size Mattress Pad Pillow Top Mattress Cover Cotton Top 8-21" Fitted Deep Pocket Breathable Fluffy Soft Cooling Mattress Topper (78x80 Inches, White)
features: Since the mattress pad is packed in a vacuumed bag, it is highly recommend to keep it spread under the sun for a few hours first or throw it in a dryer with low heat for 30 mins, so it would return to the normal thickness
King 78"×80", deep Pocket fits mattress 8-21 inches deep, including extra-deep pillow top mattress or mattress with a foam topper. Elastic fabric pocket all around secures the pad into position

300TC 100% combed cotton surface gives superior comfort against your skin without extra heat and sweat. Filled with snow down alternative filling, a state-of-the-art fiberfill that has the feel of authentic goose and duck down without the feathers or poking. Soft and noiseless material will not disturb your value sleep
Square quilted seam design assures the filling remains evenly distributed and prevents the filling shifting around. This square quilting seam is more supportive than the normal diamond
Easy to keep it clean: Machine washable and tumble dry on low heat. After multiple washings, it still holds up its shape and fluffiness without tearing, clumping, leakage, and pilling

details.Special Feature: plush, fitted deep pocket, comfortable, breathable, soft
